methods.label: Compare the increase with the original amount
methods.explanation:
The phrase “\(x\%\) greater than \(B\)” measures the increase relative to \(B\). The increase from \(B\) to \(A\) is \(A-B\), so
\[
\frac{x}{100}B=A-B.
\]
Since \(B>0\), we may divide by \(B\), obtaining
\[
x=100\left(\frac{A-B}{B}\right).
\]
This is choice A.
